info.title: Restaurant Practice API
info.description: Supabase/PostgREST backend for a restaurant testing sandbox. Demo brands, fictional prices, and simulated card payments. All amounts are integer USD cents. Includes legacy booking exercises. This specification documents the supported workflow and test cleanup; elevated service-role table grants also permit administrative raw CRUD, which is intentionally not a checkout interface. Local Swagger proxies supported calls and injects credentials server-side. For direct server-side calls use the apikey header; never put a backend secret in a browser.

delete.summary: Delete one demo order and its items/payment
delete.description: Administrative test cleanup only. Require an exact id filter. With return=representation, response is an array of deleted rows; [] if already absent. Without Prefer, successful deletion returns 204. The local proxy refuses unfiltered deletes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact UUID filter; never delete without a filter.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Use return=representation for a JSON response. Without it, writes default to minimal responses.

400.description: Invalid filter, input, or business rule.

204.description: Deleted; no response body when return=minimal is used.

post.summary: Place an order with optional coupon and simulated card
post.description: Atomically inserts order, item snapshots, and one simulated payment. Prices come from the database. Discounts round down to cents. A declined card returns HTTP 200 with status payment_failed; it does not mean payment succeeded. Invalid carts or coupons create no partial records. This is not a real payment gateway.

SupabaseApiKey.name: apikey
SupabaseApiKey.description: Backend sb_secret_ key. Do not enter this key in browser Swagger. The local docs server injects it securely from .env.

order_number.description: Automatically assigned globally unique number; gaps are normal.

p_order_id.description: New UUID per checkout. Reusing it returns 409. In local Swagger only, the all-zero placeholder is replaced with a fresh UUID on Execute.

p_items.description: Distinct available menu items from the chosen restaurant. Prices are looked up server-side.

p_coupon_code.description: One reusable restaurant coupon; blank/null means no coupon. Case-insensitive; whitespace trimmed.

p_test_card.description: Simulation only. Do not send card numbers or real payment data.
